title: The Source Where Water Begins Its Teaching

features.name: the emergent pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water rises from hidden depth, clear and teaching itself how to flow. Each surface pattern is a lesson in motion.

features.name: the teaching ledger
features.desc-on-touch: A stone worn smooth, bearing marks that water made. You find yourself standing where someone stood to listen.

features.name: upstream currents
features.desc-on-touch: The water breaks into a dozen voices as it spills over stone, each one speaking a different dialect of descent.

features.name: the stone stairs
features.desc-on-touch: Worn steps where water has been teaching for longer than anyone remembers. Each step is smoother than the last.

features.name: the mist threshold
features.desc-on-touch: Spray rises and catches light. Beyond it, the path continues upward into a landscape that water is still learning how to read.

inscription: where water learns to teach itself downstream

reverie.title: REVERIE — source pool at noon
narr: She kneels at the pool where the source rises, and you
watch her hold a cup to the current. Listen, she says.
Not to the falling, but to what the water is learning.
Her hand moves through the pool slowly. The water follows.
It follows because she understood something first:
teaching and falling are not the same. The source agrees.
